capabilities: Build citation graph canvases from Zotero collections
Expand papers with references and citing works
Group papers into overlapping tag clusters
Track reading status with colored borders
Summarize and recommend papers via an LLM
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The plugin is free, but LLM summaries and recommendations bill your Claude subscription or API account. A separate full guide covers every command, setting, and limitation. No telemetry; reads and writes only within the vault. Downloaded PDFs are stored in the vault, so add the folder to .gitignore or Obsidian Sync's excluded folders.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to visualize how academic papers cite each other or to build a citation graph from a reference manager.

relations.evidence: Build a canvas from a Zotero collection or tag
A free Semantic Scholar API key
Download PDFs from arXiv into a vault folder
Claude CLI (default) uses your Claude subscription instead of an API key

requires.name: Zotero API key and user ID

summary: Canvas-based tool that builds literature citation graphs from Zotero, expands references via Semantic Scholar, and tracks reading status.
